name: Fighter
equipment: (a) chain mail or (b) leather, longbow, and 20 arrows
(a) a martial weapon and a shield or (b) two martial weapons
(a) a light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) two handaxes
(a) a dungeoneer's pack or (b) an explorer's pack

1.name: Fighting Style
1.desc: Choose a fighting style (see the sheet)

1.name: Second Wind
1.desc: Bonus action, heal d10 + level, 1/short rest

2.name: Action Surge
2.desc: One extra action, per short rest

17.name: Action Surge
17.desc: One extra action, 2 per short rest

styles.name: Blind Fighting
styles.desc: Blindsight 10 ft: see through darkness and blindness, and invisible creatures that aren't hidden.

styles.name: Dueling
styles.desc: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

styles.name: Great Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice of two-handed or versatile melee weapons held in two hands (keep the reroll).

styles.name: Interception
styles.desc: Reaction with a shield or weapon: reduce a hit on an adjacent ally by 1d10 + prof.

styles.name: Protection
styles.desc: Reaction with a shield: impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally.

styles.name: Superior Technique
styles.desc: One Battle Master maneuver and one d6 superiority die (short rest).

styles.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Draw thrown weapons as part of the attack; +2 damage with them.

styles.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Add your ability modifier to the off-hand attack's damage.

styles.name: Unarmed Fighting
styles.desc: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + STR (1d8 with no weapon or shield); 1d4 to a creature you grapple at the start of your turn.

3.name: Arcane Archer Lore
3.desc: Arcana or Nature, and Prestidigitation or Druidcraft.

3.name: Arcane Shot
3.desc: Once per turn, apply a known Arcane Shot option to a bow attack (choose on hit); 2 uses per short rest; two options at 3rd, one more at 7th, 10th, 15th, 18th. Save DC 8 + prof + INT.

7.name: Magic Arrow
7.desc: Arrows you fire from a bow count as magical.

7.name: Curving Shot
7.desc: Bonus action after missing with a magic arrow: reroll against another target within 60 ft.

15.name: Ever-Ready Shot
15.desc: Regain one Arcane Shot use when you roll initiative with none left.

3.name: Rallying Cry
3.desc: Second Wind also heals up to three allies within 60 ft for your fighter level.

10.name: Inspiring Surge
10.desc: Action Surge lets an ally within 60 ft make a reaction weapon attack (two allies at 18th).

15.name: Bulwark
15.desc: When Indomitable rerolls your INT, WIS or CHA save, an ally within 60 ft that failed the same save rerolls too.

3.name: Combat Superiority
3.desc: Maneuvers fueled by superiority dice, short rest

7.name: Know Your Enemy
7.desc: 1 min outside combat: DM says if a creature is equal/superior/inferior in 2 traits

15.name: Relentless
15.desc: Roll initiative with no superiority dice: regain 1

3.name: Bonus Proficiency
3.desc: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or a language.

3.name: Born to the Saddle
3.desc: Advantage on saves to stay mounted, land on your feet from short falls, mount or dismount for 5 ft.

3.name: Unwavering Mark
3.desc: A creature you hit in melee is marked: disadvantage attacking others near you; if it damages someone else, bonus action attack with advantage and +half level damage (STR mod uses per long rest).

7.name: Warding Maneuver
7.desc: Reaction with a melee weapon or shield: add 1d8 to the AC of you or an adjacent creature against a hit, resistance if it still hits; CON mod uses per long rest.

10.name: Hold the Line
10.desc: Creatures moving 5 ft within your reach provoke opportunity attacks; your opportunity hits drop their speed to 0.

15.name: Ferocious Charger
15.desc: Once per turn, hitting after a 10 ft straight move: STR save or prone.

18.name: Vigilant Defender
18.desc: An extra reaction on every other creature's turn, only for opportunity attacks.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete
7.desc: Add half proficiency (round up) to STR, DEX and CON checks without proficiency; running long jumps +STR mod ft.

18.name: Survivor
18.desc: At the start of your turn, with half HP or less (but above 0), regain 5 + CON.

3.name: Manifest Echo
3.desc: Bonus action: an echo of you within 15 ft (AC 14 + prof, 1 HP); move it 30 ft free, swap places for 15 ft of movement, attack and make opportunity attacks from its space.

3.name: Unleash Incarnation
3.desc: With the Attack action, one extra melee attack from the echo; CON mod uses per long rest.

7.name: Echo Avatar
7.desc: Action: see and hear through your echo up to 1,000 ft away for 10 min, blind and deaf yourself.

10.name: Shadow Martyr
10.desc: Reaction: teleport your echo next to an attacked creature so the attack targets the echo; once per short rest.

15.name: Reclaim Potential
15.desc: When your echo is destroyed, gain 2d6 + CON temp HP; CON mod uses per long rest.

18.name: Legion of One
18.desc: Keep two echoes at once; regain one Unleash Incarnation use on initiative with none left.

3.name: Spellcasting
3.desc: INT third-caster with wizard spells known, mostly abjuration and evocation (some from any school); two cantrips (three at 10th).

3.name: Weapon Bond
3.desc: 1 h ritual bonds up to two weapons: you can't be disarmed of them and summon one to your hand as a bonus action.

7.name: War Magic
7.desc: After casting a cantrip with your action, bonus action weapon attack.

10.name: Eldritch Strike
10.desc: A weapon hit gives the target disadvantage on its next save against your spell before your next turn ends.

15.name: Arcane Charge
15.desc: Action Surge also lets you teleport 30 ft.

18.name: Improved War Magic
18.desc: After casting a spell with your action, bonus action weapon attack.

3.name: Psionic Power
3.desc: Psionic dice (d6, twice prof bonus, long rest; bonus action regains one per short rest): Protective Field (reaction, reduce damage), Psionic Strike (+die + INT force), Telekinetic Movement.

7.name: Telekinetic Adept
7.desc: Psi-Powered Leap (bonus action, fly twice your speed this turn) and Telekinetic Thrust (Psionic Strike can knock prone or push 10 ft, STR save).

10.name: Guarded Mind
10.desc: Psychic resistance; spend a die at turn start to end charmed and frightened effects.

15.name: Bulwark of Force
15.desc: Bonus action: up to INT mod creatures within 30 ft get half cover for 1 min; once per long rest or spend a die.

18.name: Telekinetic Master
18.desc: Telekinesis without components (INT), bonus action weapon attack each turn while concentrating; once per long rest or spend a die.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.desc: Smith's tools and the Giant language.

3.name: Rune Carver
3.desc: Inscribe known runes (two at 3rd, more later) on gear after a long rest: each gives a passive benefit and a once-per-short-rest invocation (cloud, fire, frost, stone, hill, storm).

3.name: Giant's Might
3.desc: Bonus action for 1 min: Large size, advantage on STR checks and saves, +1d6 to one weapon hit per turn (prof bonus/long rest).

7.name: Runic Shield
7.desc: Reaction: an attacker that hits a creature within 60 ft rerolls (prof bonus/long rest).

10.name: Great Stature
10.desc: Grow 3d4 inches; Giant's Might extra damage becomes 1d8.

15.name: Master of Runes
15.desc: Invoke each rune twice per short rest.

18.name: Runic Juggernaut
18.desc: Giant's Might deals 1d10 extra, can make you Huge with +5 ft reach.

3.name: Bonus Proficiency
3.desc: History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or a language.

3.name: Fighting Spirit
3.desc: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temp HP (10 at 10th, 15 at 15th); 3 uses per long rest.

7.name: Elegant Courtier
7.desc: Add WIS to Persuasion; WIS save proficiency (or INT or CHA if you have it).

10.name: Tireless Spirit
10.desc: Regain one Fighting Spirit use when you roll initiative with none left.

15.name: Rapid Strike
15.desc: Once per turn, trade advantage on an attack for an extra attack on that target.

18.name: Strength Before Death
18.desc: Reaction when dropped to 0 HP: take an extra turn before falling unconscious; once per long rest.
